mutations.name: the wake brief reads only each check's newest run
kills: a ci-red wake over a failure that a newer skip hides (tp#3329) hands the fixer the push run's failed mutants job, though the PR-edit run's skip is the newest run

mutations.name: a run still going behind a newer skip counts as a hidden failure
kills: a ci-red wake over a failure that a newer skip hides (tp#3329) hands over no run still going behind a newer skip, since it has not failed

mutations.name: every failure behind a newer skip is handed over, past a rerun still going
kills: a ci-red wake over a failure that a newer skip hides (tp#3329) hands over nothing while a rerun is still going between the failure and the newer skip
